title: Gameplay announces events; AudioManager alone plays sound
intent: Decouple presentation from gameplay so each event is heard once and future systems (pickups, blackouts, allies) only emit

attempts.approach: name the scene's bus field events
attempts.failureReason: it shadows Phaser.Scene.events, so the field is called bus

evidence.description: 38 checks, one sound per event including each Giant cue, nothing accumulates across four restarts

constraints.statement: Gameplay code never calls scene.sound; it emits on the run's GameEvents bus and AudioManager.listen holds the one cue table
The bus and AudioManager live for one run and are destroyed on scene SHUTDOWN, so a restart never stacks listeners, loops or music
enemy-hit fires once per enemy per 50 ms burst; stomp hits are silent there and heard once in mech-stomp
The Giant emits giant-attack per phase (windUp, active, recovery) and giant-rock-landed rather than playing sounds

result.summary: 10 E2E suites, 389 checks pass; build passes
